caveats: Sea cells = region cells with finite SST on every target day (3293 of 3600 grid cells; the 307 excluded cells are NaN on all 92 target days, consistent with land). Thresholds and climatology use the 1992-2002 baseline with the method's +/-5-calendar-day windows, which reach 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05; hence baseline_analysed spans those extension days. Computation in float64; SST compared in kelvin as stored. The single regional event ends on 2010-07-23, the last day before the first day on which no sea cell is inside a per-cell MHW.
